verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents official MCP servers ('Airbyte Agents') that let MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex connect directly to Airbyte data, confirmed both in docs and via probe of the dedicated docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and more detail on setup/configuration specifics beyond the docs page.
